values.heading: Rear Garage ADU Zoning and Rental Preconditions
values.text: For 18 Cedar Lane, a detached rear-garage dwelling conversion requires zoning eligibility confirmation, a residential building permit, at least one documented parking/access solution, emergency egress, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, light and ventilation evidence, utility plans, and final inspection before lawful rental advertising.

values.title: Rear garage ADU zoning guidance updated
values.body: Planning and building guidance now lists zoning, permit, parking/access and rental prerequisites for detached garage conversions.
